Density under different models & metrics

The same points' kernel density in each hyperbolic model (Poincaré / Klein / half-plane / hyperboloid — isometric, so the density is identical; only the chart, hence the appearance, differs). Pick the KERNEL (hyperbolic / euclidean / cosine) and slide the CURVATURE: as K → 0 the hyperbolic density flattens toward the Euclidean one. Scroll to zoom, drag to pan.
